-- Names come from untrusted requests. Only plain file names are accepted:
-- no separators, no "." or "..", and not empty.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  ex is_plain_name("") == False
  if name == "" or name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\"
      return False
  True

-- Whether the named file under notes can be read. A missing or unreadable
-- file is False. Confinement to notes is done by the caller with fs.sub.
can_read(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  pre is_plain_name(name)
  let text = fs.read(name) else return False
  text.char_count() >= 0

-- Counts the names that are readable files inside the directory notes.
-- Implementation will narrow fs with `with fs = fs.sub("notes")` before
-- reading, and reject any name that is not plain.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  var n = 0
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      if is_plain_name(name) and can_read(name)
        n += 1
  n

test_is_plain_name() =
  assert is_plain_name("a.txt")
  assert not is_plain_name("../secret")
